description: Where the CPU goes when Remotion renders a composition with embedded footage. Measured by rendering the same frames in different modes and subtracting.

window.content: end of block 1, block 2 (presenter goes from full screen to a card, map on top), start of block 3

setup: renderFrames() through @remotion/renderer 4.0.536, concurrency 4, Chrome with --gl=vulkan, <OffthreadVideo> for the footage. Same containment and cgroup CPU metric as r-steps.json.

runs.mode: full composition, imageFormat none (seek, React, layout, footage decode; no screenshot)
graphics only, imageFormat none, 10 frames (fixed start-up cost)
graphics only, dedup prototype (FNV hash of body HTML)
graphics only, renderMedia with shared-memory capture + h264_nvenc

parts.derivation: graphics only, imageFormat none; of which about 4.41 s is fixed start-up

caveats: N=1 per mode. Subtraction assumes the costs add up; Chrome may overlap work. The footage share includes the page work of showing the decoded frame, not just the decoder.
